UnitStatement: DEC-001 (Accepted): Adopt a code-neutral architecture with mechanics in the public core and code-specific values in user/private rule packs.
DEC-002 (Accepted): Adopt a 3D centerline/frame solver as the primary global analysis model; local FEA remains a specialized handoff.
DEC-003 (Accepted, pending legal review): Exclude protected standards/code data from public examples, libraries, reports, and rule packs.
DEC-004 (Accepted): Use Chirality-style flat package/deliverable decomposition with context envelopes.
DEC-005 (Accepted): Treat generated software results as decision support; human professional responsibility remains non-transferable.
DEC-006 (Accepted 2026-04-30): Add PRD-derived coverage corrections for persistence, section properties, concentrated loads, solver diagnostics, headless execution, and solve-execution UX.
DEC-007 (Accepted 2026-04-30): Add PKG-00 Software Architecture Runway as the first workflow gate before remaining package-level document drafting or implementation planning.
DEC-008 (Accepted): Use PKG-00 SEMANTIC_READY content as the SCA-001 architecture-basis candidate for sealed brief injection, without treating it as ISSUED.
DEC-009 (Accepted): Adopt Rust core/application services, Tauri 2 desktop shell, TypeScript/React/Vite GUI, and Three.js viewport as the implementation runtime/UI baseline; exact versions remain TBD.
DEC-010 (Accepted): Adopt JSON Schema 2020-12, schema-first command/query/job/result envelopes, and canonical JSON with JCS-compatible hashing as the schema/API/persistence baseline.
DEC-011 (Accepted): Adopt Cargo tests, Vitest, Playwright, validation gates, protected-content/provenance gates, and deterministic solver/rule verification gates as the software test baseline.

DEC-012 (Accepted): Keep exact dependency versions, solver numerical library, rule expression grammar, public API transport, import/export formats, CI provider, coverage thresholds, and project container as implementation-level TBDs unless resolved by a sealed brief or human ruling.

DEC-013 (Accepted): Admit PRD v0.2 as the SCA-002 working design basis and reframe the product as an analysis-grade piping design engine and stress-model authoring environment with a full internal solver.

DEC-014 (Accepted): Add PKG-13 through PKG-16 for design knowledge/constraints, states-runs-comparison, handoff/prover workflow, and model operation/agent proposal framework while preserving existing package IDs.
DEC-015 (Accepted): Treat comparison and external-prover metadata as diagnostic/handoff support, not automatic professional validation, approval, certification, or code-compliance status.

DEC-016 (Accepted): Defer commercial stress-software output parsers, formal prover lifecycle enforcement, automatic professional acceptance records, advanced route optimization, and dynamic analysis promotion unless a later SCA reprioritizes them.

DEC-017 (Accepted): Accept the MVP local storage profile: SQLite is the local project store/index, canonical JSON/JCS is domain truth, FTS5/BM25 sidecars are rebuildable, NumPy sidecars optional non-authoritative, large files referenced by path/URI plus hash, and no hosted DB, daemon, network, cloud sync, telemetry, or plugin SQL access is authorized.

DEC-018 (Accepted): Accept the D-01 unit-catalog recommendation: SI-canonical internal unit set with dual display catalog, exact definitional conversion constants as governed values, dual absolute/interval temperature semantics, explicit gauge/absolute pressure kinds with no silent atmospheric default, and a two-tier conversion-witness tolerance policy.

DEC-019 (Accepted): Accept the D-08 schema-migration recommendation: two-track versioning (store schema via SQLite user_version; model documents via per-document semver with explicit transform chain), migrate-in-memory-on-open with persist-on-save, and no silent destructive rewrites.

DEC-020 (Accepted): Accept the D-13 operation-seam unification: adopt the wasm32 build of operation_applier as the sole browser-mode operation engine, retire the TypeScript mirror's validation/apply logic, and stand up the DEL-00-01 ADR surface with this as ADR-0001.

DEC-021 (Accepted): Accept D-10 Option B: a deterministic scriptless single-file HTML document emitted by a Rust renderer crate is the canonical hash-bound calculation-report artifact (SHA-256, three-point linter gating, local bundled assets), plus a non-hash-bound print-to-PDF view; a hash-bound PDF emitter is deferred to D-10b.

DEC-022 (Accepted): Accept D-02 Option A: freeze the in-repo typed expression AST as the canonical rule-pack grammar (no text parser), extended to the full PRD section 12.3 function set, with grammar_version semver bound in the JCS-hashed checksum and a golden conformance corpus; a writable text syntax is deferred to D-02b.

DEC-023 (Accepted): Accept D-03 Option C: implement a hand-rolled in-repo sparse skyline/banded direct solver (bandwidth-ordered DOF numbering, skyline storage, in-repo LDL-transpose/Cholesky factorization, single-threaded fixed operation order, zero new numerical dependencies) with benchmark evidence under FR-008.

DEC-024 (Accepted, Part 1 superseded by DEC-026): Accept D-04 options T-B + C-C; Part 1 set a single global relative tolerance as a governed value; Part 2 (C-C coverage) sets blocking surface-inventory gates plus non-blocking numeric coverage telemetry and remains in force.

DEC-025 (Accepted): Accept D-05 Option D: defer hosted CI; codify the five-surface local evidence sweep as one deterministic sequential entrypoint emitting a commit-bound summary artifact, required as the pre-push/fan-in merge gate for every parallel agent branch; GitHub Actions on the private monorepo remains prohibited.

DEC-026 (Accepted, supersedes DEC-024 Part 1): Adopt D-04 Option T-C: numerical verification tolerances organized by reference-result class with per-quantity-kind governed relative+absolute pairs, analytic class seeded at 1.0e-9 relative, unmeasured values remain TBD, and fixture-local tolerance overrides may only tighten (any loosening is a governance event).

DEC-027 (Accepted): Rule D-07: maintainer quorum is one (sole human authority is sole developer/maintainer/release authority); external contributions are not accepted, so no CLA/DCO is stood up; any future opening of contribution intake is a new human-gated decision (D-07b).

DEC-028 (Accepted): Accept D-09 Option C: the native project package and public transport form is a multi-member archive package (zip/directory) per PKG-17 contracts with member inventory, manifest, and per-member JCS hashes; canonical-JSON members carry domain truth and SQLite remains a rebuildable projection; evidence binds to canonical members and manifest hashes.

DEC-029 (Accepted, superseded by DEC-035): Rule D-14 Option O-B: hold the Working Desktop Application Standard target stage at PRD R2 exit until packaged-runtime GUI journey evidence exists; verification finding F-4 must close via a human-performed manual smoke recorded in apps/desktop/SMOKE.md.

DEC-030 (Accepted): Accept the operation contract corpus (fixtures/model_operations/contract_corpus/, 57 cases run identically by both engines) as human-reviewed; all values invented, PUBLIC_DOMAIN_OR_ORIGINAL, no protected standards content; review_status moves to human-reviewed.

DEC-031 (Accepted): Accept all three labeled ASSUMPTIONs of the C1 grammar tranche (DEL-06-02): the 18-relation DIMENSION_PRODUCTS closed-enum table, derived unit-reference composition for dimensional products/quotients, and the conservative Select branch-compatibility freeze; grammar v1.0.0 content unchanged.

DEC-032 (Accepted): Accept contract-corpus cases 58-65 (subtraction/range combination accept and block cases) as human-reviewed under the same provenance certifications as DEC-030; future corpus additions require their own review entry.

DEC-033 (Accepted): Resolve the DEC-019 follow-up: additive model-document shape changes (new optional fields) bump the per-document version at the minor level (this tranche moves 0.1.0 to 0.2.0 with a no-op transform-chain entry); patch is reserved for non-shape changes; breaking changes remain major/explicit-migration.
DEC-034 (Accepted): Accept the result-metadata basis token solved_from_global_linear_system into the results.schema.yaml basis enum (additive), closing that tranche's schema-vocabulary residual.

DEC-035 (Accepted, supersedes DEC-029): Advance the Working Desktop Application Standard target stage from PRD R2 to PRD R3 exit (D-14 Option O-C); Phase C becomes in-stage; two blocking residuals must close before R3 exit review: F-4 (packaged-webview GUI journey, TP-MAC-141) and the A3 authoring-journey usability finding.

DEC-036 (Accepted): Accept the TP-C3-LIBSTORE-001 private-library persistence policy: the local_libraries store is private-by-default and persists only an accepted PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY import; suspected-protected (QUARANTINE) or blocked (REJECTED) imports are refused with nothing written.

DEC-037 (Accepted): D-02b ruling Option O-C: no writable expression text input ships in C2 (re-presented later with evidence); the C2 composer may show a deterministic one-way display-only AST-to-text rendering with no parser built; the typed AST remains the sole canonical checksum-bound form.

DEC-038 (Accepted): Ratify the additive library_value_ref rule-pack schema member as permanent (optional on RequiredInput, additionalProperties:false, reference-only resolved at run time, never embedded) and bump the rule-pack schema_version 0.2.0 to 0.3.0 under the DEC-033 additive-minor policy.

DEC-039 (Accepted): Ratify the additive rule-pack schema members acceptability_relation (on CheckDefinition) and solver_result_ref (on RequiredInput) as permanent, and bump the rule-pack schema_version 0.3.0 to 0.4.0 in a single minor step introducing both together.

DEC-040 (Accepted): Adopt the Cycle-Driven Resolution Doctrine as project posture: the SCC condensation is the unique objective dependency skeleton; each SCC is resolved by one recorded move (decompose/invert/merge/cut, cut/merge human-gated); operational machinery and a DAG-007 re-derivation are deferred to the next decomposition revision/SCA.
The v0.7 decomposition is the accepted current decomposition basis after SCA-004.

PREPARATION may scaffold package and deliverable folders from the decomposition after ORCHESTRATOR plans accepted downstream refreshes; PKG-00 remains SEMANTIC_READY (not ISSUED) but its SCA-001 architecture basis as amended by SCA-003/SCA-004 may be injected into PKG-01 through PKG-17 sealed contexts and future TASK briefs.
Type 2 execution requires one sealed deliverable context, explicit write scope, applicable invariants, and acceptance criteria.

Existing DEV-001 dispatch, DAG/blocker, lifecycle, dependency, implementation-evidence, schema, docs, and code surfaces may be stale relative to revision 0.7 until refreshed; SCA-004 does not directly update downstream schema/code/runtime artifacts or approve DAG-005 as active graph authority.
